# Elder Force Index

*EMA of the price change times volume.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Elder Force Index** under **Volume**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `13` |
| Color | color | `"#F23645"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/efi.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Elder Force Index", shortTitle: "EFI", overlay: false, format: "volume" });
const length = input.int("Length", 13, { min: 1 });
plot(ta.ema(ta.calc([ta.change(candle.close, 1), candle.volume], (d, v) => d * v), length), { title: "Elder Force Index", color: input.color("Color", "#F23645", { group: "Style" }) });
hline(0, { title: "Zero", color: "rgba(120,123,134,0.5)", style: "dashed" });
```
